items.title: Lovie Austin Interview, 1969-04-25
items.q: And I think he played at the Pekin, the old Pekin and the Dreamland too.

ctx.x: To join King Oliver here. Yes. And King Oliver, he went over on the gardens, the Royal Gardens.
Yes, the Royal Gardens. And I think he played at the Pekin, the old Pekin and the Dreamland too.
No, I don't think he played at the Dreamland.
